full_text:
The 2026 NFL season is just around the corner, which means more NFL player props are being released with each passing week. I previously broke down the [2026 NFL Passing Touchdowns Props](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/articles/2026/nfl-player-props-receiving-yards), and it’s time to dive into the 2026 NFL Passing Touchdown Leader odds for the top quarterbacks. In this article, I highlighted a bet I’ve already dropped in our Betting Discord and a couple of additional wagers I considered.

Our subscribers [cashed +2800 odds](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/articles/betting/2025/nfl-most-passing-touchdowns-odds#/) on __Matthew Stafford__ to lead the NFL with 46 passing touchdowns last season. He easily bested __Jared Goff__ (34, +900), __Drake Maye__ (31, +8000), and __Dak Prescott__ (30, +1500), who were the only other quarterbacks to throw for 30+ TDs. __Joe Burrow__ is the +600 favorite to win his second passing TD crown in the last three seasons. He’s followed by Stafford (+675), Prescott (+1000), Goff (+1000), and __Brock Purdy__ (+1200) at 12/1 odds or shorter.

\>Be sure to check out [Brolley’s Best Bets: 2026 NFL Futures](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/series/2025/best-bets) for my favorite futures bets all offseason…Subscribe to the Best Bets Podcast on your [favorite platform](https://www.fantasypoints.com/media/podcasts/show/nfl-best-bets) and on [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@FantasyPointsBetting) for year-round NFL betting talk…Join our “#official-bets” [Fantasy Points Discord](https://www.fantasypoints.com/media/discord) to see our staff's wagers as soon as we make them!

#### __Historical Hints__

This has been a market to bet on players with longer odds. Quarterbacks with +2000 odds or longer have thrown for the most TDs in six of the last nine seasons, including __Matthew Stafford__ (+3000) last season. __Lamar Jackson__ (+22500) had the 34th-longest odds in 2019, which means he had longer odds than some backup QBs.

It’s been a must for the league leader in passing TDs to quarterback a team with a winning record over the last decade. Burrow and __Russell Wilson__ (+3300) are the only QBs in the last 10 years to lead teams that finished below 10 victories. The league leader in passing TDs has reached 12+ wins in six of the last seven seasons.

The league leader has also reached 36+ scores in eight consecutive seasons and nine times in the last decade, which equates to a little more than 2.1 touchdown passes per game. There have been no real trends in terms of the age of the passing touchdown leader. Mahomes (2018) and Jackson (2019) each led the league at 22 years old, while Brady (2021) doubled them up by doing it at age 44, and Stafford (2025) did it at 38 years old.

Brolley’s Leans
---------------

#### __{{Dak Prescott|QB|DAL|18055}}__ (Dal) most regular season passing touchdowns (+1000, Bet365)

+ __Why I like Prescott__: Prescott ranks third in completions/game (23.9), second in TD passes/game (1.96), and first in end-zone targets/game (2.73) since returning from his catastrophic leg injury during the 2020 season. He threw just 11 TDs in eight games in 2024, but he turned things around with 30 TDs with George Pickens teaming up with CeeDee Lamb at WR. The Cowboys are expected to score plenty of touchdowns, with the fourth-highest [implied team total](https://x.com/ConnorAllenNFL/status/2057527213222727779?s=20) based on Vegas lines for the upcoming season. Prescott finished behind only Matthew Stafford with 50 end-zone attempts, and the Cowboys ranked 11th in pass rate over expectation (.7%) from inside the 20-yard line.

+ __Why I ultimately passed__: Dak needs better injury luck as he’s missed significant chunks of time in three of his last six seasons. He has arguably the NFL’s best WR tandem, but he could be hamstrung if Lamb or Pickens misses time. His touchdown rate has dipped to 4.6% over the last two seasons after sitting at 5.2% over his first eight years. The Cowboys face the [NFL’s fourth-hardest schedule](https://www.sharpfootballanalysis.com/analysis/nfl-strength-of-schedule/) based on win totals.

#### __{{Brock Purdy|QB|SF|23241}}__ (SF) most regular season passing touchdowns (+1200, BetMGM)

+ __Why I like Purdy__: He owns an elite 6.2% TD rate through four seasons, which ranks behind only Lamar Jackson (6.5%) among active QBs. The 49ers signed one of the premier touchdown scorers of his generation to give Purdy a downfield and red-zone weapon. Mike Evans ranks 10th all-time and behind only Davante Adams among active players with 108 TD receptions. The 49ers ranked sixth in PROE from inside the 10-yard line (5.7%) last season without Evans in the mix, and Purdy tied for fifth with 2.44 end-zone attempts per game. San Francisco’s schedule isn’t as easy as last season’s slate, but they’ll still face the [NFL’s sixth-easiest schedule](https://www.sharpfootballanalysis.com/analysis/nfl-strength-of-schedule/) based on win totals. The 49ers also have the seventh-highest [implied team total](https://x.com/ConnorAllenNFL/status/2057527213222727779?s=20) based on Vegas lines for the upcoming season.
+ __Why I ultimately passed__: I bet on Evans to lead the NFL in [receiving touchdowns](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/articles/betting/2026/nfl-player-props-receiving-touchdowns-leader#/) at longshot odds, so I already kind of have some exposure to Purdy leading the league in passing touchdowns. I also wish these odds were more in the 15/1 range or higher. Purdy missed eight games last season and has dealt with multiple shoulder and elbow injuries, which is always a little more concerning when it comes to quarterbacks. His supporting cast is also one of the most fragile entering the season. Evans (33 years old), __George Kittle__ (33), __Christian McCaffrey__ (30), and __Trent Williams__ (38) are among the best players at their respective positions. The problem is they have major age and durability concerns entering the season.

#### __{{Trevor Lawrence|QB|JAX|22490}}__ (Jax) most regular season passing touchdowns (+1800, DraftKings)

+ __Why I like Lawrence__: His season took off after the Jaguars acquired Jakobi Meyers before Week 10, which also aligned with Parker Washington jumping into Travis Hunter’s old role. Lawrence posted 9 TDs and 17.5 FPG (QB17) in his first eight games before turning in 20 TDs and 23.7 FPG (QB1) in his final nine games. Lawrence has reached 560+ attempts in each of his four healthy seasons, and he’s in the best situation he’s ever been in entering his second season under Liam Coen. He coaxed career highs in touchdown passes from Lawrence (29) and Baker Mayfield (41) in back-to-back seasons. Lawrence posted the sixth-most end-zone attempts (38) last season and ranks fourth in EZ attempts/game (2.52) over the last four years.
+ __Why I ultimately passed__: Lawrence’s career has been littered with times when it looked like he turned a corner, only for him to come crashing back to earth. His TD rate spiked to 5.2% last year in his first season under Coen, but he sat at just 3.4% through his first four seasons. He’ll need Brian Thomas to get back to his late rookie season form if he wants his best chance to lead the league in passing touchdowns, but the two have yet to show any chemistry through two seasons. BTJ is averaging 3.6/57./.33 receiving per game in 24 contests with Lawrence, compared to 6.9/87.3/.57 receiving per game in seven games with Mac Jones at the end of 2024.

#### __{{Baker Mayfield|QB|TB}}__ (TB) most regular season passing touchdowns (+3000, DraftKings)

+ __Why I like Mayfield__: He’s just two years removed from throwing for 41 TDs before playing under one-and-done playcaller Josh Grizzard. He ranks behind only Jared Goff with 95 passing TDs since he became Tampa Bay’s starter in 2023. Baker also ranks fifth in end-zone targets/game (2.43) in that span after totaling 35 EZ attempts (7th-most) last season. Baker hasn’t missed a game since he arrived in Tampa Bay, and it will take a serious injury to get him out of the lineup. He gutted through an AC sprain in his left shoulder, MCL and PCL sprains in his right knee, an oblique issue, and a biceps injury in his throwing arm to finish seventh in dropbacks (621) and attempts (543).
+ __Why I ultimately passed__: Mayfield heads into his first campaign as a Buccaneer without Mike Evans. Evans accounted for 28.4% of Mayfield’s TD passes (27 of 95) over the last three seasons despite Evans missing 23.5% of the games (12 of 51) in that span. Mayfield averaged 223.1/1.6 passing per game and 6.6 YPA in 14 games, mostly without Evans the last two seasons, compared to 253.5/2.2 passing per game and 7.9 YPA in 20 games with Evans. The Buccaneers ranked fifth in pass rate over expectation from inside the 10-yard line (5.4%) in Mayfield’s first three seasons in Tampa Bay, which could regress under new playcaller Zac Robinson__.__ The Falcons ranked 30th in PROE from inside the 10-yard line (-14.4%) the last two seasons under Robinson.

#### __{{Lamar Jackson|QB|BAL}}__ (Bal) most regular season passing touchdowns (+3000, DraftKings/BetMGM/theSCORE Bet)

\>Risk .2 units to win 6 units. [Placed July 16](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/articles/2026/brolleys-best-bets-nfl-futures#/).

We can bet 30/1 odds on the active leader in touchdown rate at 6.5%, who already has a passing touchdown crown. Sign me up! Jackson is coming off a down season because of hamstring and back injuries, and there was a general malaise around the team with the __John Harbaugh__ era coming to an end. __Declan Doyle__ will take over playcalling after __Todd Monken__ took the offense to great heights over the last three seasons. Doyle cut his teeth under __Sean Payton__ before serving as __Ben Johnson__’s offensive coordinator last year. [Per Ryan Heath](https://www.fantasypoints.com/nfl/articles/2026/new-playcallers-fantasy-football-impact), the Bears ranked second in play-action dropback rate (35%) last season, and the Broncos ranked 10th in Doyle’s last season in 2024 (29%). Lamar ranks fourth in passing TDs (22), and __Zay Flowers__ is the best in YPRR (4.60) on play-action passes over the last two seasons, but Jackson ranked 20th in play-action rate in that span.

The Ravens are likely to remain among the league’s more run-heavy offenses, but Doyle could throw it more than Monken did in recent seasons. They ranked 31st in pass rate over expectation (-6.3%) last season and 27th (-1.9%) during Monken’s three-year run. Jackson’s receiving corps could improve before the season since they’re a top candidate to sign a free-agent WR like __Stefon Diggs__. __Derrick Henry__ is going to steal his fair share of touchdowns, but Lamar just threw for a career-high 41 TDs just two seasons ago when Henry shared the league lead with 16 rushing touchdowns. Sportsbooks are expecting the Ravens to get back to dominating with the AFC’s highest win total, thanks in large part to the NFL’s [sixth-easiest schedule](https://www.sharpfootballanalysis.com/analysis/nfl-strength-of-schedule/) based on win totals. They also have the sixth-highest [implied team total](https://x.com/ConnorAllenNFL/status/2057527213222727779?s=20) at 25.5 PPG based on Vegas lines, so Jackson could find himself among the league leaders in passing TDs once again.
